en.t: HABBAA Satin Ribbon 1/4 Inch, Pack of 9 Rolls in 9 Colours, White, Silver, Black, Gold, Red, Pink, Fuchsia, Lavender and Green, for Gift Wrapping, Hair Bows, Crafts, Wedding and Eid Decor
b: PACK OF 9 ROLLS: You receive 9 rolls of satin ribbon, one roll in each of 9 different colours
9 COLOURS: White, Silver, Black, Gold, Red, Pink, Fuchsia, Lavender and Green, ready for any occasion
SMOOTH SATIN FINISH: Soft, shiny ribbon that ties into neat bows and adds an elegant finishing touch
GIFT WRAPPING: Ideal for presents, chocolate boxes, flower bouquets, giveaways and Eid hampers
CRAFTS AND DECOR: Use it for hair bows, cards, scrapbooking, sewing projects, weddings and party decorations
en.d: HABBAA satin ribbon set with 9 rolls in 9 different colours: White, Silver, Black, Gold, Red, Pink, Fuchsia, Lavender and Green. Each roll is 1/4 Inch wide. The smooth, shiny satin finish ties into neat bows and suits gift wrapping, chocolate boxes, flower bouquets, giveaways, hair bows, cards, sewing projects, weddings and Eid decorations. The pack contains 9 rolls, one of each colour.

9 ألوان: أبيض وفضي وأسود وذهبي وأحمر ووردي وفوشي وبنفسجي فاتح وأخضر، تناسب كل المناسبات
